description: Full-text search across transcripts: matching episodes with snippets, newest relevance first, 20 a page. Optional speaker person slug, podcast/topic slugs, publication year and UTC dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Speaker mode requires literal words/quoted phrases in one qualified passage and reports indexed coverage and playback windows. Needs an API key; billed per search (see list_services).

speaker.description: Canonical person slug. Matches words in qualified speaker passages only; partial indexed coverage.

topic.description: Canonical slug from find_topics; explicit empty matches nothing.

year.description: UTC publication year, intersected with the explicit date range.

name: search_transcripts
title: Search every transcript
